questions.q: In the commercial art and design context, what is the meaning of 'Packaging'?
options: The physical process of painting goods in bright colors.
The art, science, and technology of enclosing or protecting products for distribution, storage, and sale.
The weaving of large baskets for transporting yams.
The process of throwing away waste materials from the art room.
questions.explain: Packaging refers to creating customized containers and wrappings that protect goods, facilitate easy transport, and attract consumers.
questions.exam: BECE Cultural & Creative Arts: Textile Crafts, Packaging & Art Marketing
questions.subject: Cultural and Creative Arts

questions.q: One of the most important functional roles of product packaging is to:
options: Make the product completely invisible to buyers.
Increase the weight of the product so it is harder to steal.
Protect the enclosed product from physical damage, dirt, and contamination.
Change the taste of the enclosed food items.
questions.explain: Protection is a core function of packaging. A good package shields its contents from breakage, moisture, heat, and environmental dust during transit and on shelves.
questions.exam: BECE Cultural & Creative Arts: Textile Crafts, Packaging & Art Marketing
questions.subject: Cultural and Creative Arts

questions.q: How does packaging serve an advertisement function for a product?
options: By using bold lettering, attractive designs, and branding to grab the customer's attention.
By hiding the product name to create mystery.
By making loud noises when picked up.
By physically handing out flyers to passing buyers.
questions.explain: Packages act as silent salesmen. Through aesthetic design, color, logos, and typography, packaging advertises the product to potential buyers.
questions.exam: BECE Cultural & Creative Arts: Textile Crafts, Packaging & Art Marketing
questions.subject: Cultural and Creative Arts

questions.q: The readable text applied on the outside of a package that provides information such as the brand name, ingredients, and usage instructions is known as:
options: A mosaic
A caption or label
A motif
A watermark
questions.explain: Captions and labels are the typographic components of a package design. They provide critical product information, warnings, and usage guides to the consumer.
questions.exam: BECE Cultural & Creative Arts: Textile Crafts, Packaging & Art Marketing
questions.subject: Cultural and Creative Arts

questions.q: Which of the following materials is most commonly designed, cut, and folded by graphic artists to construct boxes and cartons for packaging?
options: Glass
Cardboard
Cement
Molten iron
questions.explain: Cardboard (or carton paper) is inexpensive, easy to print on, fold, and cut, making it the primary material for most box packaging designs.
